top_choice_rationale: P003 (B027) rests on a clean, analysable model, the Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonian, realised as a tunable system, with the superfluid-Mott transition and quantum gas microscopy independently reproduced for two decades and tested against theory. The role-based three-person credit (Zoller for the programme, Bloch and Greiner for the experiments) is workable. P001 is my second choice: the magic-wavelength lattice clock is mature and reproduced, but it overlaps the 2005 and 2012 prizes. P002 adds a single-name IceCube credit that I cannot judge or defend, and no award is last because at least one mature achievement is available.
